help.title: рџ“– Commands
help.intro: Commands grouped by category. Discord slash UI will show option hints for each.

cmd.config: Toggle module features for this server.
cmd.language: Set the bot language for this server.
cmd.crime: Commit a crime for risky money.
cmd.cases: Show moderation cases for a user.
cmd.softban: Softban a user (ban + unban to purge messages).
cmd.level-reward: Configure a role reward for a level.
cmd.ticket: Open a ticket without using the panel.
cmd.welcome: Configure welcome message for new members.
cmd.goodbye: Configure goodbye message for leaving members.
cmd.autorole: Manage roles auto-granted to new members.
cmd.reminder-cancel: Cancel a reminder by short id.
cmd.forceban: Force-ban any user, ignoring Discord permissions.
cmd.force-role-add: Force-add a role to a member.
cmd.force-role-remove: Force-remove a role from a member.
cmd.force-timeout: Force a member to be timed out.
cmd.force-move-voice: Force-move a member to a voice channel.
cmd.say: Make the bot send a plain message.
cmd.embed: Make the bot post a structured embed.
cmd.add-money: Owner: add coins to a user.
cmd.remove-money: Owner: remove coins from a user.
cmd.set-balance: Owner: set a user's coin balance.
cmd.reset-economy: Owner: wipe economy data for a guild.
cmd.eval: Owner: evaluate JavaScript in the bot process.
cmd.guild-info: Owner: detailed information about a guild.
cmd.user-info-advanced: Owner: full audit profile for a user.
cmd.chaos-mode: Owner: toggle chaos mode in a guild.
cmd.mass-role: Owner: assign/remove a role to/from many members.
cmd.backup-now: Owner: snapshot guild structure to JSON.
cmd.restore-backup: Owner: restore guild from snapshot id.
